question: What does v sign in front of mouth mean?
text:
If someone **sticks their tongue out between the two fingers**, it’s usually a crude gesture suggesting oral sex, specifically cunnilingus. ([en.wiktionary.org](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Appendix%3AGestures?utm_source=openai))

If they’re **just holding a V near their lips**, especially in a selfie, it may simply be a playful peace-sign pose. The placement alone doesn’t make it sexual. ([vice.com](https://www.vice.com/en/article/v-sign-fingers-peace-vagina-pose-photo/?utm_source=openai))
